text:
maria: wondering about short-surge handling in the token/leaky setup. current behavior stalls on 1-3s spikes and we see a lot of clients hitting retries. thinking of a 'soft-drop' + small grace-budget approach to avoid queueing latency. any concerns?

jonathan: can you outline the config you'd want? e.g. `grace_budget_ms: 3000`, `surge_reservoir: 50`?

maria: exactly. idea is per-key token bucket for steady-state, plus a tiny burst reservoir that can be consumed immediately for very short spikes. once reservoir is empty we respond with a soft 429 (Retry-After) instead of piling on queue latency.

sam_k: how do we keep it fair across orgs? if one noisy app drains the reservoir could starve others.

maria: reservoir should be per-key and a small shared org-level pool as backstop. also set a per-org decay on reservoir credits: credits += refill_rate * dt, capped. short window only.

lee_ops: telemetry needs: `grace_used_pct`, `soft_drop_count`, `avg_surge_duration`, and per-key reservoir level. add a dashboard tile and a 5m alert if soft_drop_rate > 1%.

devex-amy: console UX note: display "surge credits" for each key with tooltip "refill X/sec; used for short surges (<=3s)" and link to docs. default to on, but allow orgs to opt-out or tune.

jonathan: implementation sketch: token bucket fields plus `reservoir_capacity` and `reservoir_refill_ms`. Pseudo: 
```
struct Bucket {
  tokens; refill_rate; last_ts;
  reservoir; reservoir_refill_ms;
}

on_request(req) {
  refill_tokens();
  if (tokens >= cost) { consume(tokens); allow(); }
  else if (reservoir >= cost) { reservoir -= cost; allow_with_metric(); }
  else soft_drop(); // respond 429, lightweight
}
```

maria: that covers it. also plan for a short backoff multiplier if clients keep retrying (exponential jitter).

sam_k: testing concerns: add perf test for 2s/5s spikes and fairness test across 50 keys. also ensure we don't make SLOs worse by queuing.

lee_ops: agree. will add telemetry pipeline changes and a dashboard mock. also recommend a canary: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 6h if metrics look ok.

maria: rollout + fallback: if soft_drop_rate spikes then automatically shrink reservoir and route low-priority keys to best-effort capacity or cheaper model variant.

jonathan: add integration test that simulates 1k req/s steady + random 3s bursts and asserts p95 latency < target and soft_drop_count within expected bounds.

sam_k: one more: include an emergency opt-out header so partner integrations can request 'no-soft-drop' but require approval + logging.

devex-amy: will draft console copy and docs snippet for the feature and the recommended defaults.

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: canary=10% for 15m, gate checks: soft_drop_rate < 0.5% and p99 latency <= baseline + 20%

maria: plan: 1) design config schema 2) infra + runtime change 3) telemetry + dashboards 4) console + docs 5) canary rollout. I'll open PRs for 1-2 today.

jonathan: +1

sam_k: +1

deploy-bot: PR opened: #4219 (maria)
